newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end down, off 1,060 high.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end down, off 1,060 high.

text.p: Austrian shares stormed to an intraday high of 1,060.80 on Tuesday, boosted by strong demand from abroad, but eased off later in the session to close weaker.
The ATX index of 21 blue chip shares closed down 0.66 points or 0.06 percent at 1,053.53. Among its constituents were 10 losers, 10 gainers and one share remaining unchanged.
Traders said a correction was expected after the recent strong performance of the ATX index.
"I think we will see a small correction which could last for the next few days but the upward trend will continue," one said. Resistance is seen at 1,060.
Oil and chemicals group OMV and Lower Austrian utility EVN shed nearly all their gains in the second half of the day as a result of profit-taking, traders said.
Steel firm VA Stahl had the highest turnover at 63,000 lots.
Creditanstalt preferred shares led the gainers, up 2.29 percent at 487.9 schillings, while luxury hosiery maker Wolford was the leading decliner, down 3.28 percent at 2,650 schillings.
The broad based Vienna bourse index closed 0.14 points lower at 408.05.
